guardianLines.greeting: Welcome, little one. Watch the tide, and let it guide your hands.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: Today's tide is the same for everyone. Ride it your own way.
guardianLines.trialIntro: Here comes my biggest wave. Show me the rhythm you've learned.
guardianLines.respectLine: You swim like one of us now.
guardianLines.oneStar: You rode the wave! The sea has more to teach you.
guardianLines.twoStar: Lovely form. The current liked you.
guardianLines.threeStar: Perfect rhythm. The sea is smiling.
guardianLines.incomplete: The tide went out. It always comes back. Try again?
guardianLines.defeatLine: You rode right past me. Well swum, friend.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Your finest swim yet. I felt the whole sea move.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome to the Nile. Take your time. A careful hand goes far here.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The river runs the same for everyone today. Steady hands win.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The river is rising. Keep your footing and cross to me.
guardianLines.respectLine: The Nile makes way for you. Safe travels, friend.
guardianLines.oneStar: You crossed! Next time, aim a little truer.
guardianLines.twoStar: A fine crossing. I saw that precision.
guardianLines.threeStar: Flawless. Even the old stones are impressed.
guardianLines.incomplete: The current won this time. Rest, then try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: My jaws closed on nothing. You were faster!
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...The old river is impressed. So am I.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome to the north. Keep the fire in your heart and stay close.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: Same snow for the whole pack today. Run your best line.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The blizzard is here. Run through it with me.
guardianLines.respectLine: The pack is proud of you. Run with us through the ice.
guardianLines.oneStar: You made it through the frost. Good start.
guardianLines.twoStar: Strong run. The ice held for you.
guardianLines.threeStar: Not a flake touched you. A legend's run.
guardianLines.incomplete: The cold won this round. Warm up and run again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The storm breaks. The wolf steps aside. Lead on.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...A new howl on the ice. It's yours.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome to the grove. Carve one steady strike at a time.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: One puzzle for every mind today. Enjoy working it out.
guardianLines.trialIntro: You know the theory. Show me how you use it.
guardianLines.respectLine: Knowledge and action, together at last. Well done.
guardianLines.oneStar: A pass! Now let's make it elegant.
guardianLines.threeStar: Not a single flaw. I'm delighted.
guardianLines.incomplete: Not solved yet. Look from a new angle and retry.
guardianLines.defeatLine: Checkmate, and elegantly played. I bow.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Remarkable. I did not see that coming.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome. Be patient like the river and you'll go far.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The river flows the same for everyone today. Go steady.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The dragon wakes. Stay calm and stand your ground.
guardianLines.respectLine: The dragon bows to your patience. Well earned.
guardianLines.oneStar: You held through the flood. Good!
guardianLines.twoStar: The river bends to your patience. Well done.
guardianLines.threeStar: Not even my torrent could shake you. Wonderful.
guardianLines.incomplete: The current carried you off. Plant your feet and try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The storm passes, and you're still standing. Bravo.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Your best yet. The dragon is delighted.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome to my gate. Every tile has its place. Can you see it?
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: One mosaic for every eye today. Find the pattern in your own time.
guardianLines.trialIntro: My gate opens for a sharp eye. Show me the pattern.
guardianLines.respectLine: The gate stands open. You see what others miss.
guardianLines.oneStar: You found the pattern! Its beauty comes next.
guardianLines.twoStar: The mosaic takes shape in your hands.
guardianLines.threeStar: Every tile in its place. A lovely mosaic.
guardianLines.incomplete: The tiles scattered. Gather them and retry.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The pattern was you all along. Come through.

guardianLines.greeting: Catch me if you can! I play fair... mostly.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: Same trick for everyone today. Let's see who spots it first.
guardianLines.trialIntro: Nine tails, nine illusions. Can you see through them all?
guardianLines.respectLine: You saw through every trick. I like a sharp eye.
guardianLines.oneStar: You slipped past my tricks. Just!
guardianLines.twoStar: Not bad. You kept your wits when the foxfire flickered.
guardianLines.threeStar: Every illusion shattered. You're sharper than my claws.
guardianLines.incomplete: Lost in my illusions? Find your way back and try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: Nine tails, all fooled. You win this round!

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome! Clear whole rows and let the light in.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: One canopy for everyone today. Find your own way through.
guardianLines.trialIntro: My feathers catch every light. Can you keep up with me?
guardianLines.respectLine: You fly like one of the flock now.
guardianLines.oneStar: You found the path! There's more to see.
guardianLines.twoStar: Nicely flown. The canopy hums with you.
guardianLines.threeStar: A perfect flight. The jungle is singing.
guardianLines.incomplete: The leaves hid the way this time. Try again?
guardianLines.defeatLine: You flew past my brightest feathers. Well done!
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Your best flight yet. I'll keep a feather for it.

guardianLines.greeting: Welcome to the plains, little one. I'll walk beside you.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The same savanna for everyone today. Walk it your own way.
guardianLines.trialIntro: Here comes the herd. Keep your footing and match my stride.
guardianLines.respectLine: The herd makes room for you now.
guardianLines.oneStar: You made it across! The plains have more.
guardianLines.twoStar: Good, steady steps. The herd noticed.
guardianLines.threeStar: A flawless crossing. I'll never forget it.
guardianLines.incomplete: The grass grew tall this time. Try again?
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Your best yet. The whole herd will hear.

guardianLines.greeting: The mountain path is narrow and the air is thin. Only the focused reach the summit.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: One path. One summit. All climbers face the same mountain today. Reach highest.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The summit awaits. With nothing but your will, prove you belong among the stars.
guardianLines.respectLine: You stand at the peak. The sun condor carries your name to the heavens.
guardianLines.oneStar: You reached the ledge, but the summit is far above.
guardianLines.twoStar: The altitude tests you, and you endure.
guardianLines.threeStar: The peak is yours. The sun shines on no one brighter.
guardianLines.incomplete: The mountain rejects the unprepared. Train and return.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The peak... belongs to you. Fly higher than I.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Higher than your highest. The sun saw it.
